name: python-worker
description: A minimal Python worker service with pytest, optional Docker support, and optional Jenkins pipeline support.
recommended_use: Use for small background workers, automation jobs, ingestion helpers, CLI services, and portfolio-ready Python service scaffolds.
smoke_test_command: set -e; test -f pyproject.toml; test -f src/python_worker_validate_smoke/main.py; test -f tests/test_smoke.py; grep -q 'from python_worker_validate_smoke.main import main' tests/test_smoke.py; PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "from python_worker_validate_smoke.main import main; main()"; echo python-worker smoke ok
